title: Two-Categorical Interpretation of a Quantum Lattice Model
exact_target: Identify the categorical structure underlying the computed lattice symmetry and decide whether it requires a two-category.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30006634 (OWR-14299913-003). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Higher Structures from Symmetries in Quantum Field Theory (2026), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2026/12, pp. 737--794. Original report and mathematical context. Incorporated report material remains under the source CC BY-SA 4.0 terms unless otherwise noted.

status_qualification: The exact lattice model is the one referenced by the source contribution. Supplying an unrelated lattice model would change the target.
